nodes.description: Public address holding the owner of the owned contract; privileged role granted in the constructor from msg.sender.
Private mapping of account balances; mutated by _transfer, _burn and the ERC20 constructor mint.
Private nested mapping of allowances owner=>spender=>amount; written by approve, transferFrom, increaseAllowance, decreaseAllowance and _burnFrom.
Public mapping marking accounts as frozen; written by the onlyOwner freezeAccount function and never checked in _transfer.
Public ERC20 token name string, hardcoded to "test".
Public ERC20 token symbol string, hardcoded to "test".
Public token decimals, 18, used to scale _totalSupply in the ERC20 constructor.
Private total token supply; scaled with exponentiation in the constructor and reduced in _burn.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, minter, allowance owner, spender and transfer source.
owned constructor; assigns owner = msg.sender with no validation of the deployer.
onlyOwner function that reassigns the owner state variable to newOwner with no zero-address check.
ERC20 constructor; multiplies _totalSupply by 10**decimals and mints the entire supply to msg.sender.
View returning the private _totalSupply.
View returning _balances[owner] for the caller-supplied address.
View returning the stored allowance for an owner/spender pair.
Public transfer that delegates to internal _transfer using msg.sender as the source account.
onlyOwner function that destroys tokens from an arbitrary account by calling _burn.
Public approval that overwrites the caller's allowance for a spender with an arbitrary value.
Public spender-initiated transfer; deducts the allowance then calls _transfer without checking the allowance was sufficient beyond SafeMath.
Public function adding addedValue to the caller's allowance for a spender.
Public function subtracting subtractedValue from the caller's allowance for a spender.
onlyOwner function toggling the frozenAccount flag for a target address; the flag is never enforced in _transfer.
Internal balance-moving routine; subtracts from the source and adds to the destination using SafeMath.
Internal burn routine; reduces _totalSupply and the account balance via SafeMath.
Internal helper that deducts an allowance from msg.sender then burns; currently unreachable dead code.
Privileged state write owner = newOwner in transferOwnership; ownership can be transferred to an arbitrary or zero address.
Arithmetic balance mutation in _transfer: _balances[from].sub(value) and _balances[to].add(value) relying solely on SafeMath.
Arithmetic mutation _totalSupply.sub(value) inside _burn.
Arithmetic mutation _balances[account].sub(value) inside _burn.
Arithmetic mutation of _allowed[from][msg.sender] with sub(value) in transferFrom before the transfer executes.
Arithmetic mutation of the caller allowance with add(addedValue) in increaseAllowance.
Arithmetic mutation of the caller allowance with sub(subtractedValue) in decreaseAllowance.
Constructor arithmetic _totalSupply = _totalSupply * 10 ** uint256(decimals) followed by minting the result to msg.sender.
Privileged state write frozenAccount[target] = freeze in freezeAccount; values are stored but never enforced on transfers.
Privileged allowance write _allowed[msg.sender][spender] = value in approve; overwrites rather than increments, enabling approval race conditions.
Caller-supplied new owner address accepted without validation.
Destination address of the transfer.
Amount of tokens to transfer.
Account whose balance is destroyed by the owner-only burn.
Amount of tokens to burn.
Source address of the delegated transfer.
Destination address of the delegated transfer.
Amount of tokens moved in transferFrom.
Spender whose allowance is increased.
Amount added to the spender allowance.
Spender whose allowance is decreased.
Amount subtracted from the spender allowance.
Address whose frozen status is modified by the owner.
Boolean flag stored in frozenAccount.
Internal source address for the balance debit.
Internal destination address for the balance credit.
Internal amount moved between balances.
Internal account whose balance and total supply are reduced.
Internal amount removed from supply and balance.
Account whose allowance and balance are reduced in the unused _burnFrom helper.
Amount deducted from the allowance in _burnFrom.
Spender granted an allowance.
Allowance value granted to the spender.
